scope: oracle prototype use, not automatic anchor discovery; no P1.3 grouping/P1.2 brightness integration

sift.distance: 1-inlier_fraction among reciprocal ratio-tested correspondences; not raw match count or a probability
sift.geometry_scope: pair-only RANSAC homography verification; no panorama, camera reconstruction or scene graph

group_reduction: minimum distance; second-nearest distance and all pair evidence retained; SIFT selects verified matches if any, otherwise explicitly unsupported cap1
assignment: require quality, absolute support and relative margin; both weak or both supported but ambiguous -> unknown; scene identities never passed into detector

decoder.rule: consecutive supported group-evidence runs, first chronological A-run then B-run; interval last A evidence -> first B evidence
decoder.query_scope: entire same source timeline for all 6 arms; no anchor-time clipping
decoder.prototype_exclusion: exclude common union of K3 prototypes from main frame scoring AND temporal decoding in both K1/K3; retain full curves with self-match flags
decoder.primary: first chronological candidate, never best IoU

semantic_identity.reason: A/B evidence and temporal view transition do not establish different physical spaces; no independent identity classifier implemented
semantic_identity.negative_scoring: count view-interval candidates on no-scene-change negatives as warnings/false candidates; do not claim negative success merely because semantic decision abstains

zero_feature_baselines: single-prototype time span also retained as shared comparison
legacy_p13: reproduce un-gated single gray 2s/16s 10%-90% readout independently; never substitute it for new gated decoder
evaluation: coarse source-reviewed frame labels only, unreviewed=null; report support/wrong/abstention separately; transition labels have distribution, not forced A/B correctness; boundary signed/abs/range-distance and IoU, all intervals and misses
model_status: CLIP optional branch not run; no declared licensed local checkpoint, no download
limitation: known development/negative clips; thresholds are uncalibrated fixed diagnostics; no parameter/prototype sweeps and no held-out generalization claim
